title: Wisconsin Woman’s Murderous ‘Dream’ Becomes Literal Nightmare
description:
Bodycam footage shows the aftermath of a Wisconsin woman's frightening "dream" at her Oshkosh apartment. Local police responded to a 911 call and found Morgan Lund hysterical, crying about an alleged nightmare that was actually reality. Her boyfriend, who can be heard asking, "Why in my sleep, bro?" survived the incident. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
